operator.name: 道頓堀大観覧車えびすタワー

inspectedImages.observations: Fixed yellow stadium-shaped lattice, outward red cabins, lower Ebisu/Donpen relief and support masts.
Circular cabin shell, glazing, horizontal seat/floor and boarding pivot.
Deep four-rail open truss, diagonal members, interior cross-braces and oval stiffeners; store behind the lower frame; shallow deity/penguin/fish relief, with a rounded fish head and downward tail.
Wheel on the south river elevation of the north-bank store, east of Ebisubashi; illuminated frame/cabins and ground-floor fascia.

registration.normal: Actual south-facing source wall, resolved by the common frontage fitter
registration.evidence: The official store pin falls inside the PLATEAU LOD0 footprint; inspected operator/manufacturer/tourism photos establish the south mounting face. The pin is not a wheel-center survey.
registration.placementEvidence: Source matching remains geographic. The user-requested compact composition translates the complete host, wheel, storefront and reflected light 80 m west without changing source shape, height or facing direction.

interpretation.reliefDetail: The inspected manufacturer-front photograph directs inset ears, raised moustache lobes, garment folds, fingers, Donpen flippers, separate bill surfaces and toes. Original closed shallow geometry uses existing muted palette blends; current dimensions and source mounting stay fixed.

composition.context: Static 48-to-12 m top envelope toward the southeast, independent of the opening camera; horizontal shapes under recorded placement and all eight landmark heights remain fixed.

motion.qr: Complete rails and 32 cabin surfaces gather into the 24 dark outer cells of the top-right QR finder. Interior relief fills its nine dark center cells; lower storefront surfaces follow their host. All source surfaces retain positive-area ownership and live poses. Wheel patches share architecture's contraction, travel and expansion path throughout the turn. Wheel, storefront and city share one clock: geometry settles at 72–90% and source paint blends to QR inks at 54–90%.
